summary: Paired wooden range lights at Southampton, Ontario: a front light on the pier and a rear light on the ridge, first lit 1883 and among Canada's first designated heritage lighthouses (2012).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Record gives 1903 as the tower year and 1883 as first lit; both are right: the station dates from 1883 (mast light) and the present enclosed towers from 1903.

notes_for_editor: Keeper roster and 1883-1913 detail rest on Lighthouse Friends alone (it cites annual reports; not verified against the Marine reports' keeper tables). Parks Canada DFHD pages did not load (placeholder only). The 1897 insubordination episode is LHF's account. Report fiscal years: reports cited are FY ended June 30 of 1901, 1903, 1905, 1907; the 1907 rear-tower move may have occurred in late 1906 or early 1907. Checker: removed an unsupported 'half a mile' for the waterworks (OCR reads 'J mile', ambiguous); metres-first units; rear-tower colours not sourced so omitted; fog signal and 1939 horn moved into Building the light.
